report:
Reviewed the complete detail_firewall claim, the sole ordinary parse/mod.rs implementation association, and both associated tests. The claim requires stable semantic item identity across CST/location edits, a separate CST stash for each represented definition, and independent backdating of equal siblings. parse_str_to_cst publishes LocalModItemSym values and dispatches represented item kinds; this entry alone does not prove stash independence.

The ordinary detail_edits_preserve_local_symbol_query_keys test directly exercises persistent source edits for functions, structs, enums, traits, impls, aliases, consts, statics, modules, uses, macro definitions and macro invocations. For each it warms an observer, asserts an empty warm trace, replaces source text, rebuilds items and asserts that observe_symbol_identity does not execute. Captured setup_root_module reparses the updated text and publishes unexpanded items; ObservedSymbol interns the semantic Symbol and its tracked observer supplies the query identity check. Captured database helpers record WillExecute events and drain the log, so the assertions meaningfully detect symbol reminting for these cases. They do not establish unchanged-sibling CST backdating or generated-item detail behavior.

The explicit TODO modules_parse_detail_firewall has an empty body, counted only as deferred evidence. Its prerequisite is completing persistent edit fixtures that move items, edit one body, insert/reorder siblings, and independently inspect symbol identity, per-item CST fingerprints, and affected/unaffected downstream execution, including generated items. This explicitly retains the location, separate-stash and sibling-independence verification gaps. Acceptance preserves that deferral and does not claim complete implementation or coverage; no new edits are required to this accounting.

Baseline verification: independently compared current raw bytes of parse/mod.rs, semantic_spec.rs and sage-test-harness/src/lib.rs with the historical input; all three match exactly. Reassessed the supplied historical rationale against the current complete claim, association metadata, test assertions and captured helpers. Source inspection is the basis of this report. I executed review start/read and the byte-comparison script, but no behavioral tests or build. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and cargo build passing; those are not executions by this reviewer.
